source_evidence: Player exact 'just attack'. R2 ordinary thrown Psychic Blade, +9, AC8, no Vex or initial SA. Actual visible receipt below, face2 +9=11 hits; damage face2+4=6 psychic HP6→0. No remaining combat turns or creature. Prior explicit 'Sure we can help' authorizes routine skiff task; independently willing Fenar and yard workers use prescribed correct leverage, no check under fixed prep. Daughter's offer is prepared and actually delivered now, unaccepted. No invented cash/XP award, further adventure, travel or V speech. D326~13:50 Orsaven boatyard, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar on quay with proprietor/daughter and workers, coach/four horses at Copper Hart. R2 V exact 'just attack' authorizes ordinary ranged Psychic Blade only. Attack genuine d20 2+9=11 hits AC8, d6 face2+4=6 psychic, Large Ochre Jelly HP6→0; dead, no Split, no further hostile turns, no Vex, BA, Sneak Attack, reactions, spell slots or extra resources spent. Combat completed D326~13:36, both V and Cirren unharmed. Single 2014 MM Ochre Jelly defeated; R1 1MP already spent, no additional expenditure. Under previously accepted skiff help and fixed prep dm-ferry-i.md, after actual threat removal Fenar willingly works the line/lifting eye with yard workers while a competent worker seats replacement pin, correct leverage with no pressure means no roll; boom visibly lifted and rescue skiff released, routine cleanup of dead ooze handled by yard with due caution. No V action, hazard, purchase, wage, fee or reward invented. Daughter thanks party and offers future pilot/downstream pickup on a later crossing if arranged, no journey or service accepted or booked. Shipwright's original receipted bill and Quenwood guarantee previously revealed: two lost ferries, promised eighth of net evening earnings, beneficiary account4-C payment on guarantee; shipwright unaware source when paid; replacement operation active. Paymaster at ordinary ferry landing is next available lead, no current share sum, recipient, restitution or operator complicity established. Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution unpaid. V has not yet visited paymaster; await next action. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 shield/boots, no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia; natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unaffected. Mara and animals healthy, purse2049gp8sp6cp rations21/feed28 LR0/6, no qualifying rest or money changes. Royal invitation delivered, councillor sponsors exploratory reciprocal intelligence proposal, confidential Kestrel copies complete, actual royal reply pending; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent, no new liaison. Conditional service-house grant signed not title; Coris packet forwarding300gp pending, optional800gp field milestone. Two orders target353 with520gp unpaid; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. All prior originals/custody unchanged. V dice delegated. Accepted play durable via immutable chunk; prior blocked owner synchronization not declared complete.
